verification_questions.question: Depends_on regex strictness: '^[A-Z][0-9]{3}(,[A-Z][0-9]{3})*$' bos string + null durumlari nasil ele alir? CSV format vs tek ref_code (D015) farki var mi?
verification_questions.codex_answer: NULL durum CHECK constraint disinda (NULL valid, default). Bos string '' regex match etmiyor — INSERT/UPDATE rejected. Tek ref_code 'D015' regex match (n=0 alternation). CSV virgul-ayri 'D015,K005' regex match. Bosluk yok, virgule sonrasi space yok.

verification_questions.question: Frontend deps split client-side mi server-side mi? Performance ve consistency.
verification_questions.codex_answer: Client-side .split(',') (tek sahip 1 kart, max ~3 dependency, perf ihmal edilebilir). Server response tek string. Backward compat: depends_on null donerse UI gostermiyor (graceful).

verification_questions.question: Migration 037 prod re-run idempotent mi? UPDATE WHERE clause guard'lari.
verification_questions.codex_answer: ALTER TABLE IF NOT EXISTS + CHECK constraint DO block IF NOT EXISTS guard. UPDATE WHERE depends_on IS NULL guard yok ama 13 mapping deterministic — re-run aynı sonuc. Mevcut depends_on'u override ETMIYOR cunku kosul mismatch durumu yok (sadece 13 kart, dogru ref_code'lara map'lenir).

verification_questions.question: P0 visual cue text-badge degisikligi accessibility (WCAG) acisindan iyilesti mi?
verification_questions.codex_answer: Evet — 2px nokta sadece renge dayaniyordu (renk korligu icin gorulmez), 'P0' text label semantic + kontrast yuksek. Tooltip aciklama ekstra non-visual erisim. WCAG 2.1 AA uyumu artmis.
